blockers: data.go.th sets isopen=false on almost every record; openness had to be judged from license_title.
OAE commodity price JSON resources point to agriapi.nabc.go.th / data.oae.go.th REST APIs with page= paging; they are not in the data.go.th datastore.
Provincial copies: 499 of 782 unique packages come from 72 provincial offices and duplicate the same indicators; กลุ่มเกษตรกร hit 338 packages (list truncated at 300).
Many commerce "market news" datasets are URL stubs to provincial office web pages (HTML), not machine-readable files.
Only 30 resources could be tested per brief; 60 listed datasets are unverified.
Department of Foreign Trade border/transit trade datasets ship one CSV per month, so a report needs folder-level concatenation.
